duration: 10-minute hold at 49 HTTP users after a 2-minute ramp; 1-minute ramp-down
authentication_model: four sequential setup logins in independent local k6 cookie jars; 49 HTTP users and one browser canary share four temporary guest sessions
workload: authenticated read-only map, Buildings page, directory, search, route catalog, Main Gate pathfinding, and health checks; no writes, presence, offline, admin, or media-management requests
browser_canary: one Chromium map canary every 60 seconds with local presence-heartbeat stub
latency_guard: overall and early/middle/late p95 <3000ms; p99 <8000ms; late p95 <= max(early p95 * 1.5, early p95 + 500ms)
vercel_memory_evidence: Production Functions dashboard observed for the LT-08 run window: average 341 MB, P75 352 MB, P95 356 MB versus 2.05 GB provisioned limit; memory P99 was not exposed by the Hobby dashboard; k6 does not measure server memory
vercel_ttfb_metric_note: Dashboard TTFB chart was labeled Demo Data and was excluded from conclusions
vercel_screenshot_evidence: Three Vercel dashboard screenshots were captured inline in the Codex conversation; the available browser screenshot interface did not expose a local file path, so no PNGs were added to this run folder
note: Retained k6 text evidence contains aggregate counts, fixed diagnostics, and timings only; no credentials, cookies, CSRF values, session identifiers, response bodies, search names, or route data. Vercel monitoring is read-only and recorded separately in vercel-monitoring-closeout.md.
